node.statement: Positive dual mass forces whole-face tightness. Since the identity in node 1.2 is a sum of nonnegative terms equal to zero, for the fixed optimum h every positive lambda_f forces h(p_f)=t, every positive alpha_i forces h(p_i)=0, and every positive beta_i forces h(p_i)=1. As h was an arbitrary primal optimum, supp(lambda) is contained in T, supp(alpha) is contained in Z, and supp(beta) is contained in O.
